name: Shadow Elf
body:
Sometimes mistaken for fetchlings, shadow elves are tall and pale, with sharp, angular features. They are very secretive and do their best to stay hidden. When encountered, they will usually be found dressed all in black with their faces hidden under full helms, heavy cowls, and grotesque masks.

Core Traits
Ability Scores You gain +2 Dex, +2 Con, –2 Wis. This trait alters ability scores.
Shadowy Resistances Traits You gain resistance 5 against negative energy damage, and a +2 species bonus on saving throws against death effects and energy drain. This trait replaces keen senses.
Weapon Familiarity Traits You are proficient with the scimitar, shortbow (including composite short bows), and shortsword. You treat the kama, kusarigama, and spiked chain as martial weapons instead of exotic ones. This trait alters weapon familiarity.
Alternate Species Traits
Dimensional Step Some elves with extraplanar ancestry have the ability to momentarily slip between dimensions. Once per day as a move action, you can teleport up to 30 feet to any unoccupied space you can see. This trait replaces elven magic.
Wings Some elves with ties to the Elemental Planes of Air, giant gas planets, or gods of the sky have developed great birdlike wings—with wingspans reaching up to 20 feet in some cases. You gain a fly speed of 40 feet (poor maneuverability). This trait replaces elven magic, low-light vision, and weapon familiarity.

Awesome Ancestries: Variant Species Options, Vol. 2 – Mortals of the Multiverse. © 2025, Far Distant Future Publishing; Author: Bryan Mangum
